_comment: Hand-authored. Unused $FF fill at the ends of banks.

regions.name: Fill: 48 x $FF
regions.description: 48 bytes of $FF running from the end of the bank's last claimed structure to $BFFE, the byte before the bank-identity byte at $BFFF that the reset path checks. No reader has been found; $FF is the erased-EPROM value, so this reads as unused space.
